items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: and I had been working with Billy Eckstine at the time

ctx.x: I had -- the closest I came, I had an interview at CBS the day before Christmas eve for the associate director, and I had been working with Billy Eckstine at the time. So he read my resume, and he started
asking me questions about Billy Eckstine, whether he's taking dope.
